# Upstream snapshot

This directory is a source snapshot of NVIDIA Omniverse's Apache-2.0 licensed [`kit-extension-sample-defectsgen`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse/kit-extension-sample-defectsgen) at commit `063b5b2`.

It is included as the extension foundation used in the documented thesis workflow. The source is vendored for traceability and is not represented as original work by Kashyap Khunt. The accompanying thesis integration, configured workflow, demonstration media, dent material sample, and downstream inspection pipeline are documented in the parent repository.
